title: Bashblog – a single bash script to create blogs
summary: Bashblog is a single bash script that generates and manages a static blog with no external dependencies, using plain text/Markdown files and standard Unix tools for posts, archives, and feeds.
problem_solved: Eliminates the complexity of setting up databases, web frameworks, or CMS systems for bloggers who want a simple, maintenance-free static blog.
why_valuable: It requires zero dependencies beyond standard Unix tools, makes blogs version-control friendly with plain text files, and can be understood/maintained by anyone who knows basic bash scripting.
